description: This file defines the ClusterMembershipService class, which manages cluster membership state, updates, and lifecycle participation within the Orleans runtime. It handles membership snapshots, updates, refresh logic, and integrates with lifecycle events.

classes.name: ClusterMembershipService
classes.description: Manages cluster membership state, updates, and lifecycle participation within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: ClusterMembershipService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with dependencies and setting up initial snapshot and update stream.

methods.name: CurrentSnapshot
methods.description: Returns the current cluster membership snapshot, updating if the underlying table snapshot has changed.

methods.name: MembershipUpdates
methods.description: Provides an asynchronous stream of membership snapshot updates.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the membership snapshot to a specified target version.

methods.name: TryKill
methods.description: Attempts to kill a specified silo in the cluster.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Background task processing membership updates from the membership table and publishing snapshots.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Participates in the silo lifecycle, starting and stopping the membership update processing.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes resources used by the service.
